rules.statement: A mortgage executed after a seizure but before the registration of the seizure is void as against claims enforceable under the seizure.
rules.supporting_quote: "When a seizure of immovable property has been effected and made known and registered as in the last preceding section provided, any private alienation of the property seized, whether by sale, gift, mortgage, lease, or otherwise after the seizure and before the removal of the same, or the sale and conveyance of the property by the fiscal shall be void as against all claims enforceable under the seizure."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: "When a seizure of immovable property has been effected and made known and registered as in the last preceding section provided, any private alienation of the property seized, whether by sale, gift, mortgage, lease, or otherwise after the seizure and before the removal of the same, or the sale and conveyance of the property by the fiscal shall be void as against all claims enforceable under the seizure."
